description:
The VIPCOO VS6 is built for riders who demand power, stability, and off-road freedom. Whether you’re navigating city streets or exploring rugged outdoor terrain, this scooter delivers the strength, control, and durability needed for confident riding.
Product Selling Points
1. Powerful 48V 1000W Motor for Confident Riding
The high-output 48V 1000W motor provides instant torque and strong acceleration, making steep climbs and challenging terrain easy to conquer.
2. 48V 18.2Ah High-Capacity Battery for Longer Trips
Enjoy 25–34 miles of dependable riding per charge, suitable for long commutes or weekend adventures.
3. 10-Inch Vacuum-Proof Off-Road Tires
The 10-inch puncture-resistant off-road tires deliver superior grip, shock absorption, and stability on gravel, dirt, and uneven surfaces.
4. 4.5-Inch LED Display for Clear Ride Information
A bright 4.5-inch LED panel keeps speed, battery level, mileage, and system alerts easily visible at all times.
5. NFC Keyless Unlock for Convenience & Security
The advanced NFC unlocking system allows secure, key-free access—perfect for riders who value fast daily operation.
6. IPX4 Water Resistance for All-Weather Riding
Ride confidently in light rain thanks to IPX4-rated splash protection covering key electrical components.
7. Foldable Frame + Adjustable Handlebar Height
The foldable design and adjustable handlebar make transport easy and ensure a comfortable fit for riders of various heights.
8. Supports Riders up to 265 lbs
The reinforced frame accommodates riders up to 265 lbs, offering both strength and stability.
9. Front & Rear Dual Disc Brakes + Electronic Brake
Equipped with dual mechanical disc brakes combined with an electronic brake system, the VS6 provides powerful, responsive stopping performance for greater safety, especially at higher speeds.
10. Front & Rear Swing-Arm Spring Suspension
The dual swing-arm spring suspension absorbs bumps and rough terrain, delivering smoother, more comfortable rides across city streets and off-road paths.
Call to Action
For riders who crave power, endurance, and true off-road capability, the VIPCOO VS6 is the ultimate partner—upgrade your ride today.
